question: Some of the features of Samudragupta are shown on Satavahana coins, one of which shows him playing the ______?
solution:
The correct answer is __Veena.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The ruler of the Samudragupta, which is known as the golden age of India, has achieved significant achievements in the arts, literature and sciences during this period.
 
• He is filmed to play Veena on his coins, which reflects his interest and skill in music.
 
• Veena is a traditional Indian instrument that has been used in different forms for thousands of years.
 
• This filming represents the cultural and artistic attitude of the sea, not only the warrior he has learned, but also a patron of the arts.
 
• The rule of the sea is particularly recognized for blossoming scientific Indian music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Gupta clan:
 
• The Gupta clan is about 320 to 550 CE. Ruled up to and considered the highest level of ancient Indian civilization.
 
• This period is known for its great achievements in various fields, including arts, architecture and sciences.
 
• The Gupta Empire has a large portion of the Indian subcontinent and is famous for its culture and practices.
 
• Indian classical music:
 
• Indian classical music is divided into two major traditions: Hindustani (North Indian) and Karnataka (South Indian).
 
• Veena is a prominent instrument in both traditions, but it is more common in Carnatic music.
 
• Indian classical music is based on tunes (melodic frameworks) and talas (rhythmic wheels).
 
• Coins in ancient India:
 
• Coins are not just a medium of exchange, but also the propaganda path that the rulers use their power and achievements.
 
• Gupta coins are specifically identified for their artistic quality and the information they provide about that period.
 
• Films on coins often contain images of rulers, gods and wealth.
 
• ​Veena:
 
• Veena is one of the oldest Indian music instruments, and there are indications that return to ancient texts such as Vedas.
 
• It has a large, resonant body and is played by plucking the strings by pressing them on the fretboard.
 
• There are a variety of veins such as Saraswati Veena, Rudra Veena and Strange Veena.
